description: From XP's connected resale + primary order book. Use when the user wants to browse the live offer book of listings open on XP (e.g. 'what's open near me this weekend', 'open listings with active offers'). Filterable by event, performer, and amount. Requires auth and read:bids scope. Do not use for casual ticket buyers; this is the seller-side and power-user marketplace surface. For standard ticket purchases, use `search_events` and `get_ticket_listings`.

days.description: Only include offers created within this many days.

limit.description: Max offers to return after fetch.

max_amount_usd.description: Maximum total for the whole listing in dollars (all its tickets together), not per ticket.

min_amount_usd.description: Minimum total for the whole listing in dollars (all its tickets together), not per ticket.

sell_to_xp.description: If true, only offers where sell_to_xp is true.

sort_by.description: Sort field: created_at, event_date, amount, state, updated_at.

name: list_open_listings
title: List Open Listings
